name: sizing-composition
title: Sizing: Composition
description: Compare the same form in cards with 16px and 12px insets. Panel spacing changes while text roles and control behavior remain consistent. Headers, fields, and actions share alignment edges; footer backgrounds reach the bottom even when cards stretch to equal height. Narrow layouts stack without fixed field heights or negative-margin adjustments.
